description: What the crowd feels. Without `symbol`: market sentiment — Fear & Greed history, Altcoin Season, CBBI cycle gauge, BTC/ETH dominance, CMC AI market takeaways, channel news summary, and what people post (mostly X): most talked coins, talk rising (posts well above the coin's normal week — attention often comes before the move), most positive / negative. With `symbol` (1–10 coins): each coin's crowd mood — % of posts that are positive, posts on X in 24h, talk vs its normal week, mood in plain words. Use for 'what are people saying about X', 'is X hyped', 'market mood', 'cycle position'. The crowd is often wrong at extremes (very hyped + very positive can mean a top) — mood, not a signal. market_pulse has the short market version.

symbol.description: Optional: 1–10 coins, comma-separated (e.g. 'ZRO' or 'SOL,PEPE') for each coin's crowd mood

name: sentiment
